title: How to Cancel Spotify Premium — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Spotify Premium in 60 seconds. Keep your playlists and listening history. Direct steps for web, iOS, and Android.
intro: Spotify makes cancellation easy — you keep all your playlists and listening history on the free tier. The only things you lose are ad-free playback, offline downloads, and unlimited skips.

steps.title: Go to your Spotify Account page
steps.text: Open spotify.com/account in your browser and log in. You cannot cancel through the Spotify mobile app — it must be done via the web.
steps.tip: Bookmark this page. Spotify deliberately makes it hard to find from within the app.

steps.title: Scroll to "Your plan" and click "Change plan"
steps.text: On your account overview page, find the "Your plan" section. Click "Change plan" to see all available options including cancellation.

steps.title: Select "Cancel Premium"
steps.text: Scroll to the bottom of the plan options. Click "Cancel Premium". Spotify may offer you a discounted rate or a free month to stay.
steps.tip: If you're offered 3 months at $0.99, that's a legitimate offer worth considering if you use Spotify daily.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Click "Yes, cancel" on the confirmation page. Your Premium features continue until the end of your current billing cycle, then you switch to the free tier automatically.
steps.tip: Download any offline playlists to a local device before your Premium expires — offline downloads disappear immediately when you switch to free.

warnings: You cannot cancel Spotify Premium through the mobile app — you must use a web browser.
If you subscribed via Apple App Store or Google Play, cancel through their subscription management instead.
Offline downloads are deleted immediately when Premium expires. Save any must-have playlists offline elsewhere.
If you're on a Family or Duo plan, only the plan manager can cancel. Other members will be switched to free tier.

faqs.q: Will I lose my playlists if I cancel Spotify Premium?
faqs.a: No. All your playlists, saved songs, followers, and listening history are preserved on the free tier. You only lose ad-free playback, offline downloads, and unlimited skips.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Spotify?
faqs.a: Spotify doesn't offer refunds for unused portions of your billing cycle. However, if you were charged after already canceling, contact support at support.spotify.com for a billing dispute.

faqs.q: What happens to my Spotify Wrapped data?
faqs.a: Your listening data and Wrapped history are preserved even on the free plan. You'll still get your annual Wrapped summary.

faqs.q: How do I cancel Spotify Family plan?
faqs.a: Only the plan manager can cancel. Go to spotify.com/account → Your plan → Change plan → Cancel Premium. All family members will revert to individual free accounts.

refund.details: Spotify does not offer refunds or prorated credits. Your Premium access continues through the end of your current billing period after cancellation.

retentionTactics: Spotify often offers a discounted rate (e.g., 3 months for $9.99 total) when you try to cancel.
They may suggest downgrading to a cheaper plan (Duo instead of Family, for example).
You'll see a summary of what you'll lose (downloads, ad-free, high quality audio) to create FOMO.
